Rashi on Shevuot 15b:1:1.hebrew: וכי תימא דמחמץ לשיריים - דלא קפיד קרא אלא אקודם קמיצה, שלא יקטיר קומץ מחמץ למזבח, כדכתיב סיפיה דקרא: "כל שאור וכל דבש לא תקטירו":
Rashi on Shevuot 15b:1:1.english: And if you would say that one leavens the remainder - [You might say that] the verse is concerned only with [leavening] before the kemitzah [removal of the handful], so that one should not offer up a handful of leavened [dough] on the altar, as is written at the end of the verse: "No leaven and no honey shall you offer up in fire":

Rashi on Shevuot 15b:2:1.hebrew: אלמה לא - בתמיה: וכי לא אפשר לקדשה במנחת חמץ? הא אפשר דניקדשה בשתי הלחם הבאים בעצרת, שהן חמץ, כדכתיב (ויקרא כג): חמץ תאפינה:
Rashi on Shevuot 15b:2:1.english: Why not - [This is stated] in astonishment: Is it not possible to consecrate it with a leavened meal-offering? Surely it is possible to consecrate it with the two loaves that are brought on Shavuot, which are leavened, as it is written (Leviticus 23): "They shall be baked leavened":

Rashi on Shevuot 15b:3:1.english: From yesterday - From the eve of the Festival:

Rashi on Shevuot 15b:3:2.hebrew: בשחיטת כבשים הוא דמיקדשי - אף על פי שבאים מתרומת הלשכה, קדושת דמים היא זו, אבל קדושת הגוף לפסול ביוצא לא קדשי אלא בשחיטת שני כבשי עצרת, שהלחם בא עמהם. דגמרינן מלחמי תודה ששחיטת הזבח מקדשתן, כדאמרינן במנחות (דף עח:): "קרבנו על זבח תודת שלמיו" — מלמד שאין הלחם קדוש לקרותו קרבן אלא על ידי זביחת התודה. והכי נמי בזביחת כבשים קדשי, ואין הכבשים נשחטין אלא ביום טוב:
Rashi on Shevuot 15b:3:2.english: It is [only] with the slaughter of the lambs that they become consecrated - Even though [the loaves] come from the [funds of the] Temple chamber's collection, this is [merely] consecration of their monetary value. But [as for] bodily consecration, [which serves] to disqualify [the loaves] if they leave [the Temple courtyard], they become consecrated only with the slaughter of the two lambs of Atzeret [Shavuot], since the loaves come together with them. For we derive from the loaves of the thanksgiving-offering that the slaughter of the sacrifice consecrates them, as we say in Menachot (78b): "His offering, with the sacrifice of his peace thanksgiving-offering" — this teaches that the bread is not sanctified to be called an offering except through the slaughter of the thanksgiving-offering. And so too, [the loaves] are consecrated with the slaughter of the lambs, and the lambs are slaughtered only on the Festival:

Rashi on Shevuot 15b:5:1.hebrew: נבנייה ביום טוב - יגמור את הבנין ביום טוב:
Rashi on Shevuot 15b:5:1.english: We build it on the Festival - [meaning] he would complete the building on the Festival:

Tosafot on Shevuot 15b:3:1.hebrew: [שייך לע"ב] בשחיטת כבשים הוא דקדשי - ולמאן דאמר תנור מקדש, נמי לא מצי אפי להו מאתמול, דלא ליפסלו בלינה. ופלוגתא היא בפרק שתי הלחם (מנחות דף צה:):
Tosafot on Shevuot 15b:3:1.english: [This belongs to the other side of the page.] It is [only] with the slaughter of the lambs that they become consecrated - And according to the one who says that the oven consecrates [the loaves], [we] also could not bake them from the day before, so that they would not become disqualified by remaining overnight. And this is a dispute in the chapter [entitled] Shtei HaLechem (Menachot 95b):
